verdict.rationale: AgentMail can be operated entirely via API, SDKs, and a dependency-free native CLI binary, and agents can self-register to obtain API keys with no human UI step. This supports headless, programmatic automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., non-interactive CLI auth via environment variables, pipeline examples), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Create, manage, and operate email inboxes entirely via API.
It ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies.
The agent registers itself using the human email you provide and gets back an API key, inbox ID, and organization ID.
